meta.name: score-use-cases
meta.description: Compare competing customer use cases by value, feasibility and evidence. Use when several problems compete for delivery capacity.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给多个抢资源的需求打分,按价值和可行度排出该先做哪个
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果好几个需求抢同一批人手,却说不清该先做哪个
copy.tagline_en: Score competing use cases by value and feasibility to decide what ships first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if several demands compete for the same delivery team and you must pick.

howto.what: 按价值、可行性、证据三个维度给多个候选客户用例打分排序，产出对比结果。开始前会先读任务上下文契约和评分方法两份参考文件。
howto.when: 当多个问题同时争夺交付资源、需要排出先后顺序时使用。由 @fde 调用时，直接沿用其当前已脱敏的数据包和范围。

say.text: 有三个客户需求在抢这季度的人力，帮我按价值和可行性排个序
这个用例的证据够不够支撑它排第一？
沿用 @fde 现在的数据包，别重新做一遍调研
say.note: 复用已有上下文，不重启流程

howto.what_en: Scores and ranks competing customer use cases by value, feasibility and evidence. It first reads the task context contract and the scoring method before investigating or acting.
howto.when_en: Use when several problems compete for delivery capacity. When called by @fde, it reuses that packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Three customer asks are competing for this quarter; rank them by value and feasibility.
Is the evidence strong enough for this use case to rank first?
Reuse @fde's current packet, don't redo discovery.
